clue.text: Retribution seems in fashion

indicators.note: to fashion something is to shape it anew, so these letters are reworked into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Vengeance has apparently become the trendy thing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fashion' looks like part of 'in fashion' but is a verb telling you to rearrange SEEMS and IN together.
explanation.definitionFit: Nemesis is a just punishment that inevitably catches up with wrongdoers, a synonym for retribution.

clue.text: Prison's a devil when old

definitions.meaning: British slang for a police station or jail
A traditional name for the Devil

explanation.surface: A jail is described as diabolical in former times.
explanation.definitionFit: Nick is British slang for jail, and with 'Old' in front it names Satan.

clue.text: It will remind me to go to the doctor

parts.note: MO is a Medical Officer, a military doctor

explanation.surface: A note written to oneself as a reminder to book a doctor's appointment.
explanation.definitionFit: A memo is a written note whose purpose is to jog someone's memory.

clue.text: Gets out of a tight situation

definitions.text: Gets out of a tight situation

parts.words: Gets out of a tight situation
parts.note: tight is slang for drunk, so escaping that state means losing one's drunkenness

explanation.surface: Someone escapes from a difficult predicament.
explanation.definitionFit: To leave a drunken state is to regain sobriety, tight being slang for intoxicated.

clue.text: Dismisses part of the wind section, we hear

indicators.note: says the words before are to be spoken out and matched by sound

parts.note: the sax (saxophone) is a woodwind instrument in a band's wind section

explanation.surface: An orchestra manager fires some of the woodwind players.
explanation.definitionFit: To sack someone is to fire them from a job, so sacks means dismisses.

clue.text: Lines going to a ship back in port

parts.note: odes are poems, lines of verse

indicators.note: says the pair of a and ship are read in the reverse direction

parts.note: SS stands for steamship

explanation.surface: Ropes are run out to a vessel returning to harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns A plus SS into SSA, which follows ODES.
explanation.definitionFit: Odessa is a major Black Sea port in Ukraine.

clue.text: This club needs a licence

parts.note: reads like a golf club or a society needing a permit; really a long golf club whose name also means someone at a car's wheel, who needs a licence

explanation.surface: A club must obtain a licence before operating.
explanation.definitionFit: A driver is a golf club and also a motorist, who must hold a driving licence.

clue.text: A comrade in the class struggle?

definitions.text: A comrade in the class struggle?

parts.words: A comrade in the class struggle?
parts.note: sounds like Marxist politics; really a fellow pupil struggling in the same classroom

explanation.surface: A fellow revolutionary fighting the class war.
explanation.definitionFit: A fellow pupil is a companion sharing the same class at school.

clue.text: It's as rapid a variety as a house plant enthusiast may desire

definitions.text: as a house plant enthusiast may desire

indicators.note: a variety is a different form of something, so these letters are made into a different arrangement

explanation.surface: Something grows as fast as any indoor gardener could wish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a variety' rearranges IT'S AS RAPID; the apostrophe adds no letter.
explanation.definitionFit: The aspidistra is a classic hardy Victorian indoor plant prized by keen gardeners.

clue.text: Reply with an invitation to return

definitions.meaning: the words '...!' ask someone to return

explanation.surface: Responding by asking someone to come home again.
explanation.definitionFit: A comeback is a witty retort, and 'come back' literally urges someone to return.

clue.text: See man on board

parts.note: a see is a diocese, whose holder is a senior cleric; the same title names a chess piece on the board

explanation.surface: Spot the fellow on the ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A bishop presides over a see, and is also a chessman moving diagonally on the board.

clue.text: Understandably, one is nervous here

parts.note: being at the brink of something makes one anxious; the phrase for that position also means jittery

explanation.surface: It is natural to feel anxious in this situation.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on edge is an idiom for being tense and nervous.

clue.text: Some time in the past

parts.note: reads as 'once upon a time'; really time served in jail, documented as a criminal history

explanation.surface: An occasion long ago.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing time means serving a sentence, and having done so in the past leaves a criminal history on file.

clue.text: Is little skill required to sail them?

definitions.text: Is little skill required to sail them?

parts.words: Is little skill required to sail them?
parts.note: asks whether sailing is easy; really little skill is a literal rendering of the name for small boats

explanation.surface: A question whether these boats are easy to sail.
explanation.definitionFit: Small craft are little boats, and craft also means skill, giving the literal reading.

clue.text: The ambition of a pianist or doctor

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so these letters are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: A question about what a musician or a medic hopes to achieve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doctor' looks like a profession beside the pianist but is a verb signalling the rearrangement of A PIANIST OR.
explanation.definitionFit: An aspiration is a hope or goal, a synonym for ambition.

clue.text: Ball made square, amazingly

indicators.note: something done amazingly is done in a startling way, so these letters are thrown into a surprising new order

explanation.surface: A round object was astonishingly turned into a cube.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ball' looks like a sphere, which fits 'square', but it is a dance.
explanation.definitionFit: A masquerade is a masked ball, a dance where guests wear disguises.

clue.text: Hemp is used in making this jacket

definitions.text: Hemp is used in making this jacket

parts.words: Hemp is used in making this jacket
parts.note: suggests hemp fabric for a coat; really cannabis rolled into a joint, whose slang name is also a double-breasted jacket

explanation.surface: Hemp fibre is used to make a particular coat.
explanation.definitionFit: A reefer is both a cannabis cigarette and a thick double-breasted jacket worn by sailors.

clue.text: American uncle to retire to farm in Provence

indicators.note: to retire is to withdraw or go back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: Uncle Sam personifies the United States

explanation.surface: A US relative retires to a farmhouse in the south of France.
explanation.definitionFit: A mas is a traditional farmhouse in Provence, from the Provençal word.

clue.text: Headquarters' file shows where to find a serving man

definitions.text: where to find a serving man

parts.note: a base is a headquarters
a file is a line, as of people one behind another

explanation.surface: Head office paperwork records the whereabouts of a servant.
explanation.walkthrough: The serving man is a tennis player, not a waiter.
explanation.definitionFit: In tennis, the server stands behind the baseline at the back of the court.

clue.text: A flowery greeting from simple islanders

indicators.note: the answer comes out of the words that follow, running across them

explanation.surface: Unsophisticated island people welcome visitors with flowers.
explanation.definitionFit: A lei is a Hawaiian garland of flowers placed round a visitor's neck as a welcome.

clue.text: Patron who has been upset by agent

indicators.note: upset means overturned or disordered, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: a factor is an agent who buys and sells for others

explanation.surface: A sponsor was distressed by a representative.
explanation.definitionFit: A benefactor is someone who gives money or help, a patron.

clue.text: Maintain a lock up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: Keep a door locked securely.
explanation.definitionFit: To maintain a claim is to assert it, insisting it is true.

clue.text: The form master is a tutor of some quality

parts.note: class means quality, as in a player of real class
a tutor is a teacher

explanation.surface: The head of a school year is a fine instructor.
explanation.walkthrough: A form is a school class in British schools.
explanation.definitionFit: A form master is the teacher in charge of a school class in British schools.

clue.text: Sound hints for fixing a hammock

indicators.note: sound tells you to say the following word aloud and match it

parts.note: clues are hints

explanation.surface: Useful tips on how to hang a hammock.
explanation.definitionFit: Clews are the cords at either end of a hammock by which it is slung.

clue.text: It can't be passed in silence

definitions.text: It can't be passed in silence

parts.words: It can't be passed in silence
parts.note: sounds like something that must be remarked on; really a spoken examination, which cannot be passed without talking

explanation.surface: Something that cannot go by without comment.
explanation.definitionFit: An oral is a spoken exam, so a candidate must speak to succeed.

clue.text: The story's only part of the whole picture

indicators.note: only part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A tale gives just a fragment of the complete scene.
explanation.definitionFit: An epic is a long heroic narrative, a kind of story.

clue.text: Remarks players ignore as the team comes in

indicators.note: says the team piece enters inside the other word

parts.note: a side is a team

explanation.surface: Actors pay no attention to comments as their colleagues enter.
explanation.walkthrough: Asides are spoken on stage for the audience only, so the other players pretend not to hear.
explanation.definitionFit: An aside is a stage remark the other actors on stage are supposed not to hear.

clue.text: Permit one journey, but don't check the speed

parts.note: to permit is to let
I is the Roman numeral one
a trip is a journey

explanation.surface: Allow a single outing, but drive without slowing down.
explanation.definitionFit: Let it rip is an idiom for going at full speed without restraint.

clue.text: It's held musically to follow the wrong tune

indicators.note: says the word to is placed after the other piece
wrong means incorrect or out of order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A note sustained in music comes after playing the incorrect melody.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It's held' sounds like a possession; tenuto is Italian for 'held', a direction printed in a score.
explanation.definitionFit: Tenuto is a musical direction meaning a note is to be held for its full value.

clue.text: Polish woman to call back

parts.note: she is a female pronoun, standing for a woman

indicators.note: says the word call is read in reverse

explanation.surface: A woman from Poland is going to return a phone call.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Polish' looks like the nationality; it is a varnish. 'back' turns CALL into LLAC.
explanation.definitionFit: Shellac is a resin varnish used to polish wood.
